goal: XLSX export on xlsxwriter (R1, gates 162/164): replace the hand-written OOXML writer half of app/xlsx.py with Workbook(in_memory) and native charts

acceptance_criteria.text: write(dataset, rows, charts) uses xlsxwriter with strings_to_formulas, strings_to_urls and strings_to_numbers False and nan_inf_to_errors True; a cell '=HYPERLINK(...)' stays text

First sheet is 'Data' with the column names as header; one sheet per chart named '<id> <kind>' (31 chars max) holds the chart table and a native chart (line, column, doughnut, scatter); the heatmap sheet has a 3_color_scale and no chart; a chart with 0 rows gets no chart
openpyxl reopens an export with sum(len(ws._charts)) > 0 and, inside warnings.catch_warnings(record=True), without any message containing 'no default style' (AC-23)
requirements.txt pins xlsxwriter==3.3.0, python-pptx==1.0.2, openpyxl==3.1.5, pyarrow==26.0.0 and no package of those four is vendored in the repository

All hand-written writer code and constants are deleted from app/xlsx.py (only the openpyxl reader and write() remain); tests/test_export_xlsx.py chart-kind and heatmap checks are re-checked against xlsxwriter's part names
Moves acceptance items AC-18, AC-23 forward
